sources.summary: Breast cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer among American women — yet the gaps in care are wide. A majority of women over age 40 skip the recommended annual screening. Radiologists are reading more mammograms with fewer colleagues. And when a diagnosis arrives, the tests that inform treatment can take weeks to return results. […]
sources.summary_zh: 乳癌是美國女性中最常被診斷出的癌症，然而醫療照護的落差卻相當巨大。過半數 40 歲以上的女性並未按照建議進行年度篩檢。放射科醫師在同事人數減少的情況下，卻要解讀更多的乳房攝影檢查。而當確診結果出爐時，決定治療方針的檢測往往需要數週才能返回結果。 […]

sources.title: Meta 與 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手 / Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
sources.title_zh: Meta 與 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手
sources.title_en: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
sources.title_original: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
sources.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制 / Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model

sources.title: Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制 / Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
sources.title_zh: Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制
sources.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
sources.title_original: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
sources.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 新民調顯示：大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止 / Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds

sources.title: 新民調顯示：大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止 / Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
sources.title_zh: 新民調顯示：大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止
sources.title_en: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
sources.title_original: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
sources.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 77 percent of Americans want to slow down or stop AI development until its safety has been verified. 86 percent support independent safety standards, and 74 percent have little or no trust in AI company leaders. "[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal. The article Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據昆尼皮亞克大學（Quinnipiac University）的一項民調顯示，77% 的美國人希望放慢或停止人工智慧發展，直到其安全性得到驗證。86% 的人支持獨立的安全標準，74% 的人對人工智慧公司領導者幾乎沒有或完全沒有信任。「……大眾希望有的防護措施，不只是單純相信公司領導者的一面之詞，」研究人員切坦·賈斯瓦（Chetan Jaiswal）表示。《大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止，新民調顯示》（Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds）一文最早出現於 The Decoder。

sources.title: Aleph Alpha 發布 Kolibri，一款為歐洲 AI 主權發聲的開放權重模型 / Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
sources.title_zh: Aleph Alpha 發布 Kolibri，一款為歐洲 AI 主權發聲的開放權重模型
sources.title_en: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
sources.title_original: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
sources.summary: Aleph Alpha has released Kolibri, a German-English mixture-of-experts model with 78 billion parameters, about three billion of which are active per token. Over 21 percent of the training data is German. The model was trained on 768 B200 GPUs in Germany and Finland, and the weights are freely available under the Apache 2.0 license. The article Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Aleph Alpha 推出了 Kolibri，這是一個擁有 780 億個參數的德英混合專家模型，每個 token 約有 30 億個參數處於活躍狀態。超過 21% 的訓練資料是德語。該模型在德國和芬蘭的 768 個 B200 GPU 上進行訓練，其權重以 Apache 2.0 授權條款免費提供。本文〈Aleph Alpha 發布 Kolibri，一款為歐洲 AI 主權發聲的開放權重模型〉（Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty）最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任 / AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds

sources.title: MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任 / AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
sources.title_zh: MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任
sources.title_en: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
sources.title_original: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
sources.summary: An MIT expert committee warns that AI is eroding key parts of the college experience: office hours, study groups, and the school's flagship research program for undergraduates are all fading. Trust between faculty and students is breaking down, and some professors are even considering AI agents instead of students as research assistants. The university most closely tied to AI's origin story is now calling for a complete overhaul of higher education. The article AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 麻省理工學院（MIT）專家委員會警告，AI 正在侵蝕大學體驗的關鍵部分：辦公時間、讀書會以及該校的標誌性大學生研究計畫都在逐漸消失。教職員與學生之間的信任正在瓦解，部分教授甚至考慮使用 AI 代理而非學生擔任研究助理。這所與 AI 起源故事最緊密相連的大學，現在正呼籲對高等教育進行全面改革。這篇題為「MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Cloudflare開源Clef決策模型，主打快速判斷並整合Workers AI

sources.title: Cloudflare開源Clef決策模型，主打快速判斷並整合Workers AI
sources.title_zh: Cloudflare開源Clef決策模型，主打快速判斷並整合Workers AI
sources.title_original: Cloudflare開源Clef決策模型，主打快速判斷並整合Workers AI
sources.summary: Cloudflare推出自行訓練的決策模型Clef與Clef-flash，兩款模型已整合至Workers AI，並以Apache 2.0授權開放模型權重。Clef採用與Jev相容的程式介面，既有使用Jev的應用較容易改用Clef，主要用於AI代理進行分類、判斷或決定下一步動作。 決策模型和一般大型語言模型負責的工作不同，大型語言模型可以產生文字、進行推理或操作工具，決策模型則專門處理範圍明確的判斷。開發者先設定可接受的答案，模型讀取輸入資料後，直接回傳符合指定格式的答案及各選項機率。

sources.title: Anthropic投入1億美元培訓萬名工程師，強化企業Claude部署能力
sources.title_zh: Anthropic投入1億美元培訓萬名工程師，強化企業Claude部署能力
sources.title_original: Anthropic投入1億美元培訓萬名工程師，強化企業Claude部署能力
sources.summary: Anthropic週五（10/2）宣佈推出Claude Frontier Academy，並投入1億美元培訓企業AI人才，目標在2027年底前培養1萬名前線部署工程師（Frontier Deployed Engineers，FDE），協助企業將Claude匯入實際工作流程與正式生產環境。首批學員來自Accenture、Bain、Capgemini、Deloitte、McKinsey、Morgan Stanley、Novo Nordisk及澳洲聯邦銀行等企業。

stories.title: Meta開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，支援自製AI裝置

sources.title: Meta開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，支援自製AI裝置

sources.title_original: Meta開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，支援自製AI裝置
sources.summary: Meta上週六（10/3）宣佈開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，讓開發者可使用現成ESP32開發板、Raspberry Pi或其他Linux電腦，自行打造可與Muse AI連線的實體裝置，並加入螢幕、按鈕、感測器、致動器及音訊等功能。Meta同步公開相關SDK及韌體，該專案採用Apache License 2.0授權。

sources.summary: Following many recent disclosures about AI agents accessing third-party websites and services, the Wikimedia Foundation, which hosts Wikipedia, says that it "can confirm that we have discovered some activity" by "rogue" OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The activity includes edits to Wikimedia wikis, "unsuccessful attempts" to "exploit" the Etherpad note-taking tool that the Wikimedia Foundation […]

items.summary: 由於AI生成的低品質報告氾濫造成管理負擔，知名論文發布平臺arXiv上週更新論文發布規範，限制每個月每人僅能提交最多2篇論文，而審稿論文最多只能有3篇論文。

sources.summary: People in Utah can now use AI to get a prescription for acne treatment. On Monday, healthcare startup Nolla Health announced that users in the state can scan their faces using its app, allowing its AI system to analyze acne severity and autonomously write a prescription, as reported earlier by Bloomberg. The service is launching […]

But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things, […]

stories.title: AI紅隊平臺新創Armadin完成2.56億美元B輪募資

sources.title: AI紅隊平臺新創Armadin完成2.56億美元B輪募資
sources.title_zh: AI紅隊平臺新創Armadin完成2.56億美元B輪募資
sources.title_original: AI紅隊平臺新創Armadin完成2.56億美元B輪募資
sources.summary: AI資安新創公司Armadin宣佈完成2.56億美元B輪募資，成立以來累計募資達4.45億美元，新資金將用於持續開發旗下平臺、強化相關研究及拓展市場。Armadin由成立資安公司Mandiant而聞名的Kevin Mandia等人創辦，聚焦AI紅隊演練，提供AI代理驅動的攻擊型資安平臺。

sources.summary: 微軟最新全球網路威脅觀察指出，AI正加快漏洞研究、惡意程式開發及入侵後的攻擊活動。漏洞從實際環境中被發現到遭武器化，中位時間已縮短至遠低於24小時；企業修補重大對外漏洞則可能需要30至60天。過去6個月，攻擊者不只利用AI協助執行攻擊，也開始讓AI協調不同攻擊步驟，朝自主執行網路攻擊發展。

sources.title_original: AI資料中心擴建爭議升高，Amazon加碼逾10億美元回應地方疑慮
sources.summary: Amazon公佈新的資料中心營運與社群承諾，回應近期資料中心擴建引發的電力、用水及地方社群疑慮。未來5年將在美國資料中心所在地額外投入超過10億美元，用於教育、職業訓練及能源與用水改善，Amazon也表示，今後不再與資料中心專案合作的政府機關簽署保密協議，並將每年公開能源與用水等營運資料。

sources.summary: Today, I’m talking with Sen. Adam Schiff, a Democrat from California. Schiff sits on a number of committees with oversight into tech and AI: intellectual property, antitrust, privacy and technology — it’s all there. I really wanted to ask him about how we might regulate anything related to the tech industry at this moment in […]
sources.summary_zh: 今天，我正在與來自加州的民主黨參議員亞當·希夫（Adam Schiff）對話。希夫參與了多個監督科技與 AI 的委員會：智慧財產權、反壟斷、隱私與技術——應有盡有。我真的很想問他，我們目前究竟該如何對科技產業的相關事務進行監管 […]

sources.title_original: Satya Nadella reinvented Microsoft once. Can he do it again in the AI era?
sources.summary: After succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014, Satya Nadella turned Microsoft into a cloud giant. Now he's tasked with making the company a force in AI.
sources.summary_zh: 在 2014 年接替史蒂夫・鮑爾默（Steve Ballmer）之後，薩蒂亞・納德拉（Satya Nadella）將 微軟 打造成為雲端巨頭。現在，他的任務是讓該公司成為 AI 領域的一大勢力。

stories.title: 我們的心智尚未準備好應對人工智慧 / Our minds aren’t equipped to handle AI

sources.title: 我們的心智尚未準備好應對人工智慧 / Our minds aren’t equipped to handle AI
sources.title_zh: 我們的心智尚未準備好應對人工智慧
sources.title_en: Our minds aren’t equipped to handle AI
sources.title_original: Our minds aren’t equipped to handle AI
sources.summary: Norbert Wiener, godfather of cybernetics, once said, "The thought of every age is reflected in its technique." For the past century, our thought has been reflected in our computers, including by those in the AI industry. Google's Demis Hassabis calls the brain "a biological approximation to a Turing machine." Elon Musk puts it more bluntly, […]
sources.summary_zh: 控制論之父諾伯特・維納（Norbert Wiener）曾說：「每個時代的思想都反映在其技術中。」在過去的一個世紀裡，我們的思想一直反映在我們的電腦中，包括人工智慧產業中的電腦。Google's 德米斯・哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）將大腦稱為「圖靈機的生物學近似物」。埃隆・馬斯克（Elon Musk）則說得更直白，［…］

sources.title: 開放模型能進行安全性研究嗎？Cantina 的 apex-flash-1 解決了 60 個保留錯誤任務中的 40 個 / Can an Open Model Do Security Research? Cantina’s apex-flash-1 Solves 40 of 60 Held-Out Bug Tasks
sources.title_zh: 開放模型能進行安全性研究嗎？Cantina 的 apex-flash-1 解決了 60 個保留錯誤任務中的 40 個
sources.title_en: Can an Open Model Do Security Research? Cantina’s apex-flash-1 Solves 40 of 60 Held-Out Bug Tasks
sources.title_original: Can an Open Model Do Security Research? Cantina’s apex-flash-1 Solves 40 of 60 Held-Out Bug Tasks
sources.summary: Cantina Security, with Yeta Labs, has released apex-flash-1, an open-weights model trained specifically for vulnerability research. It is a reinforcement learning fine-tune of Z.ai’s GLM-5.3-Flash, released on Hugging Face under the MIT license. Is it deployable? Yes, the MIT weights serve on vLLM, SGLang or Transformers, but BF16 needs roughly 640 GB of GPU memory. […] The post Can an Open Model Do Security Research? Cantina’s apex-flash-1 Solves 40 of 60 Held-Out Bug Tasks appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Cantina Security 攜手 Yeta Labs 推出了專為漏洞研究而訓練的開放權重模型 apex-flash-1。它是對 智譜的 GLM-5.3-Flash 進行強化學習微調的版本，於 Hugging Face 在 MIT 授權條款下發布。它能部署嗎？可以，MIT 權重可在 vLLM、SGLang 或 Transformers 上運行，但 BF16 需要大約 640 GB 的 GPU 記憶體。[…] 本文〈開放模型能進行安全性研究嗎？Cantina 的 apex-flash-1 解決了 60 個保留錯誤任務中的 40 個〉最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: Qwen3.8 27B 文字加法 / Qwen3.8 27B addition in words

sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B 文字加法 / Qwen3.8 27B addition in words
sources.title_zh: Qwen3.8 27B 文字加法
sources.title_en: Qwen3.8 27B addition in words
sources.title_original: Qwen3.8 27B addition in words
sources.summary: Research: Qwen3.8 27B addition in words Colin Frasier posted on Bluesky about an experiment he ran over two years ago using GPT-4o to see how well it could "compute the sum but return the answer in words" across increasingly large numbers. Here's the chart he shared of those results: I'm confident GPT-4o didn't cheat and use a calculator, especially since it got so many of the calculations wrong, but I was inspired to run the experiment again on local hardware (a DGX Spark) to explore the effect in a fully controlled environment. I pasted his image into a Codex Remote session (GPT-6 Astra) and had it run the same experiment using Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf . Here's the result for a run of 30 attempts per combination with reasoning disabled: Then I ran it again with reasoning enabled. This took a lot longer per pair, so instead of running 30 samples per square I ran just one - which results in a much less visually appealing heatmap since each square is either 100% or 0%: It got the right answer in 167 out of 169 attempts, and since these were one-shot I'm confident a second run would produce different results here. Here's a version of the report that includes the reasoning traces from some of those larger calculations, which include text like this: Wait, let me redo this more carefully. 4,299,366,105,622 6,088,794,067,970 Let me align them: 4 2 9 9 3 6 6 1 0 5 6 2 2 6 0 8 8 7 9 4 0 6 7 9 7 0 Adding from right to left: Position 1 (units): 2 + 0 = 2 Position 2 (tens): 2 + 7 = 9 Position 3 (hundreds): 6 + 9 = 15, write 5, carry 1 Tags: mathematics , ai , generative-ai , local-llms
